_about: Per-map card pools (owner 2026-10-22). One entry per main map, three tiers: "cards" (the MAP tier), "submaps" (each side map's whole list, one list each: its own cards + the ones it carries) and "special" (the cards added through a skirmish deck editor's + Load any card; one list for the map and its submaps' fights). A main-map fight draws from cards + special; a submap fight from that submap + special (2026-10-29 LISTFIX1, decision APPLY1-1: no longer the parent's cards too). Shape: tools/lib_map_pools.js. Fold the admin's live edits back with tools/fold_map_pools.js.
